study type: Prospective randomized controlled ancillary study of a clinical trial
outcome: Fibrinolysis activation (measured by clot lysis time using GFC/LT)
Plasma concentration of fibrinolysis activators and inhibitors
cohort: The study included 33 women undergoing elective cesarean deliveries, who were part of the TRAAP2 trial.
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly increased clot lysis time, indicating a decreased fibrinolysis, compared to placebo at T15 and T120 minutes after administration.
mod_finding: GFC/LT evidenced fibrinolysis activation during cesarean delivery, linked to a decrease in fibrinolytic inhibitors.
followup_time: 120 minutes (2 hours) after drug administration post-childbirth
